body:
Founder reported it still failed even without sudo after the first fix. Real root cause: systemctl --user needs XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS pointed at the real per-user bus socket, not reliably exported in every shell/session type -- same fix this session already had to hand-apply earlier today to restart iduna.service. Script now exports both explicitly and checks the socket exists first (naming 'loginctl enable-linger' as the real fix if the user systemd instance isn't running at all). Verified live: systemctl --user daemon-reload/list-units both succeed with these exact values on this box. Commit 7f7e1ab.

⚓ ☃
title: Fixed sudo-queue/51 for real: explicit D-Bus session env, not just the sudo guard
